Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon] or [Sakuyamon] in its name and 1 Option card with [Plug-In] in its name among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[Your Turn] When you use Option cards with a use cost of 2 or more, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
